APPENDIX I

Properties of the Curl Operator and  Application                            
                    to the Steady-State Navier–Stokes  Equations

We give in the appendix some functional properties of the curl operator on a
                 bounded set of R n, n = 2 or 3, and we derive from these properties and improved
                 form of the existence result contained in Theorem 1.5, Chapter 2. Essentially, we
                 follow Section 1 of C. Foias–R. Temam [3].
